people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
translations.bsb: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
translations.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
translations.asv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in Christ.
